scan.title: ForeverDB
scan.notes: ForeverDB (foreverdb.net), the WoW Forever database, in the game. Switch off any part you don't use in Settings. A live rotation assistant for your spec. Helps by itself: upgrades for your spec on tooltips, the best quest reward, level-up summaries, vendor and profession tips, herbs, ore, fishing pools and beasts to skin for your professions, map pins. A quest helper (map and minimap pins, a waypoint arrow that follows the quest you track and points directly at its destination, distances on Blizzard's quest tracker, a guide next to the quest log, a full quest guide with the quest text, steps, rewards against your gear, the chain and players' tips, coordinates) and a dungeon helper (bosses, loot for you, quests, a panel inside dungeons). One window for everything else: vendor, trainer and weapon-skill finder, what to craft next, camping, best consumables for your level, talent plans, rotation card, buff check, raid notes. Item and NPC tooltips show what ForeverDB knows. Spots gold spam and likely bots and help
